rejectCases.note: a# is the vertex-shader address register; same encoding as t#, wrong spelling for this stage

rejectCases.name: def_dest_wrong_register_kind
rejectCases.note: def must write a c# constant register, not a general-purpose one

rejectCases.name: def_dest_write_mask
rejectCases.note: def writes the whole constant; a partial write mask has no meaning

rejectCases.name: defi_dest_wrong_register_kind
rejectCases.note: defi must write an i# integer constant register

rejectCases.name: defb_dest_wrong_register_kind
rejectCases.note: defb must write a b# boolean constant register

rejectCases.name: setp_not_available_in_sm1
rejectCases.note: SETP needs predicate support (SM3 in this assembler's non-extended version grammar)

rejectCases.name: mova_not_available_in_sm1
rejectCases.note: MOVA needs SM2+; a0 as a destination is otherwise legal VS spelling, isolating the version gate from the register-kind one

rejectCases.name: mova_not_available_in_pixel_shader
rejectCases.note: MOVA addresses the vertex-shader constant file; pixel shaders have no a0 to move into
